components.css: .ds-project-plate{max-width:560px;color:#151A19}.ds-project-image{aspect-ratio:4/3;background:#B9CFD2;border-radius:2px;transition:transform .18s ease-out,box-shadow .18s ease-out}.ds-project-plate:hover .ds-project-image{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:8px 10px 0 rgba(21,26,25,.14)}.ds-project-plate small{display:block;margin-top:16px;font:600 11px Archivo,Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.11em}.ds-project-plate h3{margin:12px 0 8px;font:600 30px/1 Archivo,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-project-plate p{margin:0;font:400 16px/1.55 Archivo,Arial,sans-serif}

narrative.overview: Bay Area editorial precision meets the warmth, resourcefulness, and landscape rhythm of a small Colorado product studio.

rules.name: Cobalt Marker Rule
rules.body: Cobalt marks consequential action or one focal fact and stays scarce.

rules.name: Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif carries authored perspective; sans-serif carries facts and action.

rules.name: Field Table Rule
rules.body: Arrange evidence on a working surface instead of floating generic cards.

dos: Make outcomes legible before implementation details.
Use annotation only to orient real information.
donts: Do not use generic gradient blobs or repeated SaaS cards.
Do not turn Colorado references into resort branding.
Do not let one project's palette become the studio identity.
